id.description: unique identifier of the website (the website will always and only have 1 banner so use the website id)

theme_id.description: unique identifier for the custom theme, if theme_id is nil then default_theme is used

default_theme.description: name of the default theme to be used

personalized_content.description: does the website have content personalized for the user?

running_targeted_advertising.description: are there targeted advertisements on the website?

share_data_to_3rd_party.description: does the Website share data with third parties?

selected_languages.description: languages the banner will auto display in based on region
